title: Executive Summary
caption: The top page of the report, built on the gold sales summary.
story: Everything on this page is read from the gold tables the pipeline writes. The tiles and the revenue trend come from the sales summary, so a green validation gate upstream is what makes these numbers safe to show.

hidden_nav.label: Click here for navigation
hidden_nav.note: This report has a hidden navigation rail. The menu button at the top left opens it, and from there you jump to any other page. Every page except the drill-through page has the same button. Click it first when you open the report.

title: Channel Performance
caption: Revenue by channel against budget.
story: The channel bars come from the sales summary. The budget comparison comes from the budget vs actuals table, which gold aggregates in the notebook so the logic is tested once and not repeated in measures.

title: Product Analysis
caption: Products and categories by the selected metric.
story: The product ranking and the margin scatter read the same sales summary table, so product numbers always agree with the channel page.

title: Rep Performance
caption: Representatives against budget.
story: This page reads the rep performance table, one of the four gold tables the model uses.

title: Trend Analysis
caption: Rolling revenue, year-on-year change and margin.
story: The long-range trend reads the same gold data. Because the model uses DirectLake, a new pipeline run shows up here without a separate import step.

title: Rep Detail
caption: Drill-through page for one representative.
story: The drill-through page is fed by the rep performance table, so it follows the same gold tables as the page it opens from.

title: Workspace items
caption: The items in the workspace: report, lakehouse, semantic model, six notebooks and one pipeline, all synced with Fabric Git.
alt: Workspace item list with one report, a lakehouse and its SQL endpoint, a semantic model, six notebooks and a pipeline. Every row shows Git status Synced.

title: Pipeline canvas
caption: The pipeline runs six notebooks in a straight chain; each step follows the previous one on success.
alt: Pipeline canvas with six notebook activities in a row, named Generate_Synthetic_Data, Validate_Bronze, Transform_Silver, Validate_Silver, Aggregate_Gold and Validate_Gold, joined by green arrows.

title: Generate step settings
caption: Generate step: 12 hour timeout and no retries.
alt: General tab of the Generate_Synthetic_Data activity: state activated, timeout 0.12:00:00, enable retries unticked.

title: Validate Bronze step settings
caption: Validate Bronze: 12 hour timeout and no retries.
alt: General tab of the Validate_Bronze activity: state activated, timeout 0.12:00:00, enable retries unticked.

title: Silver notebook, cells 1 to 3
caption: Bronze to silver: columns are cast to their types and text is trimmed.
alt: Silver notebook, cells 1 to 3: imports, then a silver date table and a silver channel table built from bronze with type casts. Printed output shows 1096 rows and 5 rows.

title: Silver notebook, cells 4 to 6
caption: Silver adds derived columns; customer tenure is measured from a fixed date written in the code.
alt: Silver notebook, cells 4 to 6: product, customer and sales rep tables. Product gets a gross margin percent, customer gets tenure in days from a date written in the code, and sales rep gets a monthly target. Printed output shows 150, 500 and 30 rows.

title: Silver notebook, cells 7 and 8
caption: Silver sales fact with derived columns and printed totals.
alt: Silver notebook, cells 7 and 8: a budget table and the sales fact table with gross profit, a return flag and a return rate. Printed output shows 180 and 50000 rows, a total gross revenue and a count of rows with returns.

title: Silver row counts
caption: Row counts of the seven silver tables.
alt: Notebook cell that prints a row count for each of the seven silver tables, from 5 rows to 50,000 rows.

title: Silver gate 1, row parity
caption: Silver gate 1: bronze and silver row counts match for every table.
alt: Notebook cell that compares row counts between each bronze table and its silver table for seven pairs. All pairs match and the cell prints Row parity: PASSED.

title: Silver gate 2, column types
caption: Silver gate 2: column types match the expected schema.
alt: Notebook cell that checks the data type of ten columns of the silver sales table against expected types. All match and the cell prints Type validation: PASSED.

title: Silver gate 3, derived columns
caption: Silver gate 3: derived columns are recomputed and agree.
alt: Notebook cell that recomputes gross profit, the return flag and the return rate and counts mismatches. Each count is 0 and the cell prints Derived column validation: PASSED.

title: Silver gate 4, business rules
caption: Silver gate 4: business rules hold.
alt: Notebook cell with three business rule checks: margin between 0 and 1, return rate between 0 and 1 and tenure not negative. Each count is 0 and the cell prints Business rule checks: PASSED.

title: Silver gate summary
caption: Silver gate summary: all four checks passed.
alt: Notebook cell that prints a summary of four silver checks, all PASSED, and the line Silver layer ready for gold aggregation.

title: Gold notebook, load
caption: Gold step starts by reading each silver table once.
alt: Gold notebook, cell 1: imports and reads of the seven silver tables once, for reuse. Output: Silver tables loaded.

title: Gold sales summary
caption: Gold sales summary: the fact joined to four dimensions and aggregated.
alt: Gold notebook, cell 2: joins the sales fact to the date, product, channel and rep tables, groups and sums, and writes the gold sales summary in overwrite mode. Output shows 50000 rows.

title: Gold budget table
caption: Gold budget table: actuals against budget with variance in basis points.
alt: Gold notebook, cell 4: actual revenue by channel and month joined to budget, with variance, variance percent and variance in basis points. Writes the gold budget table. Output shows 180 rows.

title: Gold rep performance
caption: Gold rep performance: monthly target achievement with ranks.
alt: Gold notebook, cell 5: rep performance by month with target achievement, target variance, and a dense rank and percent rank inside each year and month. Output shows 1080 rows.

title: Gold row counts
caption: Row counts of the four gold tables.
alt: Gold notebook, cell 6: prints a row count for each of the four gold tables (50,000; 1,500; 180; 1,080) and the line Gold layer ready for DirectLake connection.

title: Gold gate 1, row counts
caption: Gold gate 1: row counts match the expected values.
alt: Notebook cell that compares the row counts of four gold tables with expected values. All four match and the cell prints Gold row counts: PASSED.

title: Gold gate 2, reconciliation
caption: Gold gate 2: silver and gold totals reconcile with no difference.
alt: Notebook cell that reconciles gross revenue, net revenue and units sold between silver and gold with a tolerance. Each difference is 0.00 and the cell prints Aggregation reconciliation: PASSED.

title: Gold gate 3, business rules
caption: Gold gate 3: business logic checks pass.
alt: Notebook cell with checks on budget variance in basis points, target achievement and rank ranges. Each count is 0 and the cell prints Business logic checks: PASSED.

title: Gold gate summary
caption: Gold gate summary: all three checks passed.
alt: Notebook cell that prints a summary of three gold checks, all PASSED, with lines saying the medallion architecture is complete and ready for a Direct Lake semantic model.

title: SQL endpoint tables
caption: The lakehouse tables seen through the SQL endpoint, grouped as bronze, silver and gold.
alt: Explorer tree of the lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint listing tables under dbo with bronze, silver and gold prefixes.

title: Lakehouse attached to a notebook
caption: The lakehouse attached to the notebooks.
alt: Notebook explorer pane showing OneLake data items with one lakehouse pinned.
